title: Allowed model builds from limited annual history
points: Deterministic bank and non-financial models now run when at least one usable annual consolidated period is available instead of refusing histories shorter than three periods.
Models built from one or two periods disclose that assumptions requiring more history use the model template or industry defaults and should be reviewed.
Zero usable periods remains a hard failure because a forecast needs at least one sourced actual-period anchor.
Model-only Analyst answers now explicitly self-check their limitations and next-step sections so valuation-only terminology is not introduced into a forecast request.
The deployed model-build eval now reproduces the MARI two-period case and verifies actuals, assumptions, five forecast years, provenance, and limited-history disclosure.
